label: The rail is the rows; every figure colours by dataset
caption: Landing: the four datasets are the run list's groups (a checkbox, a swatch, a count; unfold for its trajectories), Split and Kind apply across them, and the Overview draws one row per dataset in its colour: a runs table of headline numbers, then every joint's position × speed map.

label: Tick two datasets and holdout: everything recounts
caption: Tick Cell · Conveyor PnP and UR5e alone · Workspace, then holdout: 28 of 212. The runs table and every map re-aggregate from those 28 trajectories' cells, still one row per dataset in its colour, and the line under the tabs says which subset it is.

label: Switch dashboards: the selection holds; narrow inside a dataset
caption: Tool position keeps the 28 (the rail is beside every tab). Unfold Cell · Conveyor PnP and tick two of its holdout trajectories: that dataset narrows to them (its box shows −), the other stays whole, and the maps redraw at once: 14 of 212.

label: One joint: the picker lives on its dashboard only
caption: One joint has the only joint picker; pick elbow and its three planes draw per dataset, with the share of cells each dataset visits as bars in the same colours below.

label: Trajectories: sort, drill, Open in Rerun
caption: Trajectories is data-ui's own table over the same 14 rows (dataset, split and kind as columns, the dataset badge in its colour). Click a row: data-ui's record pane opens it, with Open in Rerun and what it adds to the 212.
